transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

I've come in today because I've been feeling constantly depressed and sad for a very long time now. It has been going on continuously for about two years and three months. I just feel so weary and heavy all the time.
Have you had any period of at least two months during the past two years when you were not feeling depressed?
No, I haven't had any period of relief like that at all. I have felt consistently depressed and sad for the entire two years and three months without any breaks where I felt normal or happy.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Persistent Depressive Disorder, Major Depressive Disorder], but the patient now reports a लगातार depressed mood for over two years with no symptom-free period of at least two months. This chronic, continuous course strongly supports Persistent Depressive Disorder and makes Major Depressive Disorder less likely as the primary diagnosis because MDD is typically episodic rather than persistently present for this duration.
